entry.title: DOJ and CFTC Sue Arkansas to Halt Kalshi Enforcement
entry.summary: The federal complaint seeks protection beyond Kalshi, including a bar on investigations tied to transactions on CFTC-regulated exchanges.

entry.title: BoE and Asian Central Banks Test Linked FX Settlement
entry.summary: Project Meridian FX APAC linked traditional and tokenised test systems, but did not involve live participants or production operating conditions.

entry.title: Nakamoto Delays Kraken Debt as Bitcoin Collateral Falls
entry.summary: The company pushed a 60 million USDT payment into 2027 and gained credit for protective derivatives, but collateral requirements still allow earlier liquidation.

entry.title: Osmosis Restarts After Halt; Upbit Pauses Transfers
entry.summary: Onchain records show block production resumed after a roughly four-hour interruption. Upbit kept OSMO trading open but suspended deposits and withdrawals.

entry.title: Injective Opens Veyra Vote for Cross-Chain Trading
entry.summary: The proposed Nov. 24 upgrade adds asset-transfer and trading infrastructure, while CypherOS privacy remains on the roadmap. Voting is still below quorum.

entry.title: Bitcoin Breaks Below $69,000 as Selloff Sets New Lows
entry.summary: Ether, XRP and SOL also hit four-week lows on Coinbase, while bullish bets accounted for most tracked liquidations.

entry.title: Bitcoin Sinks to $70,600 as Four-Week Losses Deepen
entry.summary: Coinbase recorded a fresh 28-day low Thursday evening, while ether continued to underperform bitcoin over matched one- and four-week windows.

entry.title: Democrats Probe Trump’s Nvidia China Chip Export Deal
entry.summary: Wyden and Neal ask Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to preserve export and tariff records, opening a separate inquiry into the administration’s decisions.

entry.title: DOJ Disrupts North Korean Fake-Call Crypto Theft Scheme
entry.summary: Officials attribute more than $400 million in losses over 18 months to FaceStealer, which uses recordings and deepfakes to impersonate trusted contacts.

entry.title: Foster Says Nvidia Privately Deemed Chip Tracking Feasible
entry.summary: The lawmaker's account contrasts with a semiconductor trade group's warning about mandatory safeguards on advanced AI chips.

entry.title: Binance Says Hack Assets Covered, Reserve Proof Pending
entry.summary: The exchange says it has closed the remaining gap in customer backing, but users must wait for the new snapshot's cryptographic proof to verify it.

entry.title: Sky Advisor Proposes Halting New Core Vault Borrowing
entry.summary: BA Labs reports 771 open vaults and 376.33 million USDS in debt. Borrowers could still repay and manage collateral, but not mint more.

entry.title: NYDFS Sets May 2027 Deadline for Crypto Ad Policies
entry.summary: BitLicense holders and crypto trust companies must prepare annually approved marketing policies covering risk disclosures, paid promoters and misleading claims.

entry.title: Bitcoin Breaks Below $72,000 as Multiweek Slide Deepens
entry.summary: Coinbase recorded a $71,500 low, while Coinalyze's tracked derivatives markets showed $368 million in 24-hour liquidations, mostly bullish bets.

entry.title: Securitize, Ethena Open BUIDL Facility With $100M Capacity
entry.summary: The facility starts with $25 million each in USDC and BUIDL. Additional funding is conditional, rather than a continuously available $100 million cash pool.

entry.title: Layer 1, Rollups and Sidechains: The Key Differences
entry.summary: Where transactions run is only part of the difference. Ethereum, OP Mainnet, Linea and Polygon PoS show how checks, settlement and withdrawal waits diverge.

entry.title: Jensen Huang Resigns; Nvidia Names Kress Interim CEO
entry.summary: CFO Colette Kress will hold both roles during a successor search. The filing does not address the board investigation announced Nov. 8.

entry.title: Ether Nears $2,000 as Weekly Loss Outpaces Bitcoin's
entry.summary: Ether's roughly four-week loss reached 14.7%, versus bitcoin's 9.9%, while US ether ETFs recorded a fifth consecutive session of net withdrawals.

entry.title: DTCC Plans Solana Support for Tokenized Assets in 2027
entry.summary: The second-half integration would add another network to a service already live on Canton and DTCC's private Besu blockchain.

entry.title: USDT Freeze Proposals on Tron Leave Time to Move Funds
entry.summary: FreezeCheck found 65.4 million USDT left targeted addresses between public proposals and execution. The records show an exposure window, not proof that senders acted on a warning.

entry.title: India's ED Searches CoinDCX, Delta in Forex-Law Probe
entry.summary: In Nov. 6 statements, both exchanges said trading, deposits and withdrawals remained operational. Delta denied cross-border digital-asset transfers.

entry.title: CFTC Approves tZERO Exchange Ahead of $350M SPAC Deal
entry.summary: The November 10 designation follows October clearinghouse registration and satisfies an earn-out target, but merger closing conditions remain.

entry.title: Chainstack Urges Credential Rotation After Data Breach
entry.summary: The blockchain infrastructure provider says services stayed online, but customers must replace node credentials and update their applications.

entry.title: Zcash Plan Would Pull 50,000 ZEC From Grants Treasury
entry.summary: Polling starts Nov. 16 on a draft that would end ZCG's 8% funding stream and build a locked development and legal-defense reserve.

entry.title: Zcash Falls Below $965 as Weekly Loss Reaches 26%
entry.summary: ZEC's seven-day decline was roughly three times bitcoin's. The token traded about 43% below a late-September price above $1,680.

entry.title: Nvidia Board to Discuss Huang's Future, FT Reports
entry.summary: The reported leadership talks follow the board's public backing of Huang on Nov. 8. Trump said Nov. 9 that the FBI was looking into the situation, separately from the company's review.

entry.title: Katana Plans Revenue-Funded Buybacks for KAT Stakers
entry.summary: The Layer 2 will retire emissions voting and shorten its unstaking cooldown on Nov. 17. Buybacks will begin separately, with full onchain automation to follow.

entry.title: Nvidia Falls After Report of Huang Affair With Executive
entry.summary: The New York Times reported a relationship with health-care VP Kimberly Powell, who reports to Huang, raising a separate workplace-governance question while a board investigation is underway.

entry.title: Trump Backed Nvidia Diversion Crackdown, Axios Reports
entry.summary: Commerce denied a reported confrontation between Bessent and Lutnick. An independent records check found no published export-control notice naming Megaspeed.

entry.title: Ethlabs Puts Ethereum Quantum Defense Ahead of Speed
entry.summary: The lab targets quantum- and AI-resistant Ethereum in 2027, withdrawing Quick Slots from its Hegotá push and asking developers to rethink the upgrade.

entry.title: Novig Loses Bid to Block New York Gambling Enforcement
entry.summary: The judge found at the preliminary-injunction stage that Novig's sports contracts are not swaps and sharply criticized the CFTC's efforts to shield prediction markets.

entry.title: Arkham Traces $63 Million in Bitget Hack Funds to CoinJoin
entry.summary: The firm traced 847.26 BTC into mixing transactions and reported another 959.29 BTC in labelled wallets, as recovery efforts continue.

entry.title: Polymarket Cuts Staff and Contractors in Reorganization
entry.summary: Marketing was a focus of the cuts, Front Office Sports reported, as Polymarket trails Kalshi despite rising reported revenue.

entry.title: Nomura Explores Laser Digital Sale, Bloomberg Reports
entry.summary: Marex is among the potential buyers, according to Bloomberg. The talks concern a business spanning crypto trading, asset management and onchain credit partnerships.

entry.title: LlamaRisk Proposes Borrowing Speed Limits for Aave V3
entry.summary: The plan pairs timed borrowing buffers with a steward-run route for large clients. Parameters remain provisional and governance votes are still ahead.

entry.title: Extended Opens XTEN Checker With Dec. 31 Signing Deadline
entry.summary: Unaccepted allocations will move to the Ecosystem Fund. Starknet accounts must nominate a self-custodial EVM wallet, while the token launch date remains unannounced.

entry.title: Moonwell Cuts Collateral Limits, Drops VELO and wrsETH
entry.summary: MIP-X75 reduces the backing available for existing loans on Base and Optimism. Borrowers near their limits face liquidation unless they reduce debt or add eligible collateral.

entry.title: Variational Ends Omni Beta, Removes Invite-Code Gate
entry.summary: The trading API remains unavailable under Variational’s published documentation, while its VAR token is still scheduled for Q4 2026.

entry.title: Stacks Tests Post-Quantum Signatures With sBTC Transfer
entry.summary: A mainnet vault withdrawal used a Lamport one-time signature. The test does not upgrade ordinary sBTC wallets or the Bitcoin backing the token.

entry.title: White House Seeks Remote AI Chip Curbs: Report
entry.summary: The reported request targets overseas computing rentals used by Chinese AI labs, a gap Nvidia has lobbied against closing.

entry.title: Researchers Say Codex Flaw Put npm Releases at Risk
entry.summary: Depi says OpenAI fixed a chain linking prompt injection, a sandbox escape and publishing credentials. Its disclosure does not report a malicious npm release reaching users.

entry.title: Runway Releases Praxis-1 Robot Model With Open Weights
entry.summary: Apache 2.0 weights and code move the robot controller beyond partner testing, but new hardware still requires substantial adaptation.

entry.title: Maple Co-Founder Flanagan Exits Over Strategy Split
entry.summary: Joe Flanagan said he will support a handover through year-end. Maple described an agreed transition and said its direction remains unchanged.

entry.title: Pyth Adds Real-Time NYSE Data to Its Data Marketplace
entry.summary: The Level 1 feed covers five NYSE Group exchanges. Clients must license the data directly with NYSE before receiving it through Pyth.

entry.title: Anthropic Perp Exposure Tops $300 Million in Snapshots
entry.summary: Buildix readings span multiple Hyperliquid markets. The Trade.xyz contract alone showed $109.4 million, about 30% above The Defiant’s Nov. 10 snapshot.

entry.title: Keplr User Reports 1,200 ATOM Move Amid Recovery Effort
entry.summary: Onchain records confirm the staked assets moved to an address outside the Nov. 8 recovery list. That does not establish who controls it.

entry.title: OKXICE Sets Nov. 23 Stock-Token Launch After Objections
entry.summary: The venture expects more than 70 assets, including 59 Direxion ETFs, but issuer objections still constrain shares tokenized by unaffiliated third parties.

entry.title: IBM Targets 520 Qubits With Next Nighthawk Processor
entry.summary: IBM plans to link two r3 chips in 2027. Developers can use new managed quantum-classical workflows now, but the processor remains a design target.

entry.title: iOS 27.2.1 Leaves Sandbox Flaw Open, Researcher Says
entry.summary: The worse_query escape could expose wallet data stored in plaintext, SlowMist warned. Trust Wallet and Zerion said their iOS users are not affected.

entry.title: Anthropic’s $1.4 Trillion IPO Target May Rise: Report
entry.summary: The Nov. 10 share-price range implied a valuation of about $1.4 trillion. Bloomberg subsequently reported, citing the Financial Times, that bankers were weighing $1.5 trillion or more.

entry.title: xStocks Adds 200-Plus UK and EU Stock Tokens With GTN
entry.summary: The rollout includes LVMH, Rolls-Royce and SAP, but does not open xStocks to UK investors. GTN handles execution and custody of the underlying assets.

entry.title: Evernorth Slides 24% After 73.7 Million-Share Filing
entry.summary: The XRP treasury company's prospectus covers potential resales by existing investors, but it does not lift key holders' six-month lock-ups.

entry.title: LlamaRisk Proposes $1.33B Collateral Exit From Aave Core
entry.summary: Affected reserves would be frozen first, leaving existing loans open while borrowers switch collateral or migrate to V4.

entry.title: Across Urges Users to Avoid App Over Domain Issue
entry.summary: The bridge's alert does not establish whether its smart contracts or bridging operations are affected.

entry.title: Uphold Marks Crypto Withdrawal Disruption Resolved
entry.summary: Fiat deposits, withdrawals and trading continued normally while the platform worked around an outage at its transaction-monitoring provider.

entry.title: MetaMask Adds Mobile Limit Orders Across Four Chains
entry.summary: Orders use revocable wallet permissions and a default 3% price tolerance. Reaching the target price does not guarantee a fill.

entry.title: Leverage Shares Plans Cash-First Anthropic 3x ETP
entry.summary: The planned European product would hold interest-bearing assets before Anthropic’s debut, then seek three times the stock’s daily performance.

entry.title: Ether, SOL and XRP Slide as Liquidations Hit $580 Million
entry.summary: Coinbase spot markets recorded SOL below $82 and XRP below $1.05, while bitcoin extended its decline beneath $73,000.

entry.title: Banks Commit $270 Million to Stablecoin Venture: Report
entry.summary: The reported funding would cover five years of operations for the issuer, whose consortium has targeted a first-half 2027 dollar stablecoin launch.

entry.title: HYPE Falls 18% in a Week, Lagging Bitcoin and Ether
entry.summary: Hyperliquid’s token reached a four-week sampled low as daily fees recovered from an early-November dip.

entry.title: Commerce Halted Megaspeed Chip Probe After Nvidia Outreach, NYT Reports
entry.summary: The Justice Department is conducting a criminal inquiry into the Nvidia customer, according to the report, while Commerce says it handled the case by the book.

entry.title: PNC Launches USDC Payments Pilot With Coinbase
entry.summary: Eligible corporate and institutional clients can accept USDC on Ethereum, with proceeds automatically converted into dollars in their PNC accounts.

entry.title: BitGo Returns to Profit on Crypto Gains as Revenue Halves
entry.summary: Platform clients rose 33.1% year over year, but revenue after direct costs fell 32.1%.

entry.title: Norway Pauses New Data Center Grid Reservations
entry.summary: Existing connections are unaffected, but reserved capacity alone will not shield projects from a separate freeze on technical approvals.

entry.title: Pump.fun Adds Cross Margin to Hyperliquid-Powered Perps
entry.summary: The app adds TWAP execution and manual margin adjustments after launching its perpetual futures service with isolated margin on Oct. 28.

entry.title: Ledger SDK Sends Signing Metadata by Default
entry.summary: The reporting code includes destination addresses and device details; Ambire says it kept the affected versions out of production.

entry.title: Luke Dashjr Promotes Rival BIP Repository as 'Official'
entry.summary: The fork restores Dashjr's editor listing and BIP-110's 'Complete' status, while bitcoin/bips remains active with five editors.

entry.title: NVIDIA Unveils GR00T 2 With Onboard Humanoid Control
entry.summary: A 100,000-hour human-demonstration dataset and companion tools are available now, while model weights and adaptation recipes are due in December.

entry.title: Bitcoin Falls Below $73,000 to Fresh 10-Week Low
entry.summary: The Coinbase low undercut Sunday's trough by nearly 1%; Kraken also recorded a sub-$73,000 print.

entry.title: Polymarket Says Revenue Run Rate Tops $1.8 Billion
entry.summary: The US exchange recorded $14.77 billion in October face-value turnover, while its fees vary by contract price, product and trader tier.

entry.title: Visa Adds Monad to Stablecoin Settlement: The Block
entry.summary: Visa’s seven-day settlement model lets institutions move funds beyond the banking week; Mastercard announced a similar expansion in June.

entry.title: Anthropic Perp Trades Above IPO Range on Hyperliquid
entry.summary: The ANT contract references one Class A share, but gives traders no equity or IPO allocation rights and is expected to continue trading after the listing.

entry.title: MEGA Pledges $30 Million for Products, Starting With AI
entry.summary: An inference marketplace is planned for December, with the product-development budget coming from MEGA's existing treasury, according to co-founder Shuyao Kong.

entry.title: NRC Permits Four X-energy Reactors at Dow's Texas Site
entry.summary: The proposed plant would replace aging electricity and steam assets, but Dow has not made a final decision to build it.

entry.title: XRP Drops 24% in Four Weeks, Lagging Bitcoin and Ether
entry.summary: XRP's seven-day loss reached 18.3%, compared with bitcoin's 5.7% decline, as conversions of stolen XRP into bitcoin continued.

entry.title: Zcash Falls Below $1,100 as Daily Loss Reaches 10.5%
entry.summary: Monero also sank 9.2%, while bitcoin and ether posted smaller declines. ZEC traded about 31.5% below a late-September level above $1,600.

entry.title: Solana Hits Four-Week Low as Losses Outpace Bitcoin
entry.summary: SOL has lost 22.9% in 28 days, while Solana ETF trackers recorded fresh withdrawals on Nov. 6 and Nov. 9.

entry.title: Grayscale Pledges $1 Million in Zcash ETF Campaign
entry.summary: ZCSH trades on NYSE Arca and held $675.7 million in assets as of Nov. 9. Its prospectus sets a 2.5% annual sponsor fee.

entry.title: Jupiter Adds Token Baskets and Curated Yield Vaults
entry.summary: Third-party curators will run the vault strategies, while basket users authorize automatic trades from individual vaults rather than pooled funds.

entry.title: Malicious Pull Requests Target Vizor and Zingo Wallets
entry.summary: None of the six requests was merged; the campaign paired credential-stealing code with instructions telling AI reviewers not to flag secret uploads.

entry.title: Alta Raises $47.5 Million for Bank-Focused Blockchain
entry.summary: Airwallex plans to connect the network to local payment rails, while Alta builds privacy and institutional policy checks into settlement.

entry.title: Pendle Lists Four Fixed-Term USDe Markets on Ethereum
entry.summary: Initial quoted annualized yields ranged from 5.24% to 6.00%, with roughly $10,000 of liquidity in each pool.

entry.title: Fomo Adds Solana Token Trading Route to X Cashtags
entry.summary: X's existing 'Trade' workflow sends users to participating partners. Fomo says its crypto wallets are non-custodial.

entry.title: US CPI Tops Forecasts in October as Bitcoin, Ether Fall
entry.summary: A gap in October 2025 data left headline and core CPI without annual readings; ether slipped 1.9% around the release.

entry.title: Telegram Adds In-Message Widgets With TON Payments
entry.summary: Production access is limited to private bot chats, while group use and forwarding remain on Telegram's test server.

entry.title: Compound V2 Users Face Nov. 10 COMP Rewards Deadline
entry.summary: The legacy Ethereum rewards campaign opened with 40,419 COMP. Unclaimed tokens will return to Compound’s treasury after the cutoff.

entry.title: Matter Labs Launches Prividium Connect With ZK Fee Plan
entry.summary: Proposed public deployments would channel interoperability fees into ZK, but activation, integration and fee parameters still need governance approval.

entry.title: Anthropic IPO Filing Uses $78 Maximum Share Price
entry.summary: The registration covers 948.75 million shares including an underwriter option, implying a $64.35 billion base offering at the maximum registration price.

entry.title: Google Commits $10 Billion to Anthropic Alongside IPO
entry.summary: The investment will be priced at Anthropic’s IPO price, while the company has launched its roadshow with a proposed $70–$78 share range.

entry.title: Anthropic Registers Up to 948.75 Million IPO Shares
entry.summary: The amendment’s fee table uses $78 a share, while crypto derivatives require a different denominator: the company’s total outstanding shares.

entry.title: Initia Halts L1 After $605,000 USDC Outflow, Team Says
entry.summary: The team’s preliminary investigation points to compromised rollup infrastructure keys used to fabricate cross-chain transfers.

entry.title: Anthropic Retracts IPO Range as Crypto Products Await Debut
entry.summary: Liquid reported a rebound after the pricing retraction, while Ondo and Dinari’s tokenized products remain tied to public trading.

entry.title: Anthropic Launches Fable 5.2 With 20% Lower Token Prices
entry.summary: Anthropic says the model nearly matches Opus 5.5’s best FrontierCode result at roughly half the cost per task, despite higher per-token rates.

entry.title: Anthropic Launches IPO Roadshow at $70–$78 a Share
entry.summary: The proposed 825 million-share offering moves ANT toward Nasdaq, while Ondo and Dinari's tokenized-stock launches still await public trading.

entry.title: Waller Backs December Hike as Bitcoin Slips Toward $74K
entry.summary: He said a half-point increase should be considered if monthly core CPI stays around 0.3% or higher. Kalshi traders increased their December hike bets.

entry.title: WalletConnect Pitches Single-Integration Crypto Checkout
entry.summary: Binance Pay is listed as live for direct exchange-account payments, with other exchange integrations still marked coming soon.

entry.title: Ethlabs Urges Glamsterdam Hold Pending Audit Findings
entry.summary: Four reports flag deployed contracts that could break, while possible specification changes are being prototyped, the Ethereum Foundation says.

entry.title: Maple’s SYRUP Nearly Halves as Lending Assets Shrink
entry.summary: Maple’s TVL stands at $2.22 billion, while syrupUSDC assets under management have fallen to $2.36 billion from $2.68 billion reported Oct. 19.

entry.title: Coinbase, Five Firms Back CFTC in Stock Perps Lawsuit
entry.summary: The proposed amicus brief supports joint SEC-CFTC oversight as a November 10 reply deadline approaches in the bid to halt single-stock perpetuals.

entry.title: Trump Media Reports 15,649 BTC Ahead of Debt Put
entry.summary: Noteholders can demand up to about $1 billion in cash on November 30, while much of the company's disclosed bitcoin was committed to an options strategy.
